messages:
michelle_pm: Quick sync - we need UI acceptance criteria for the Optimize Recs pilot (batching/cache/quant recommendations + eval alerts). ACME wants a simple console workflow and clear guards. Thoughts?

rahul_eng: Keep runtime simple for pilot: per-route adaptive batching toggle, per-route cache TTL, int8 recommendation only. No auto-apply. One-click apply in UI must only flip feature-flag and schedule a canary.

jenna_product: UI acceptance checklist idea: (1) show suggested config + estimated perf/cost delta; (2) show estimated quality delta from offline eval and block if >1.5% rel drop; (3) audit trail of who applied/reverted; (4) revert button that reverts config and starts a 24h undo window.

alex_cs: ACME requires per-route opt-out API and CSV export of applied config history. Also wants cost delta in dollars for 1M tokens.

sara_ml: Eval-alert behavior: post-apply live eval compares outputs on customer corpus; trigger if rel_drop >2% AND abs_drop >0.005. On alert: sample 100% for 30m and optionally route to fp16 fallback if CS enables auto-fallback. PII must be obfuscated before storage.

tim_sre: Ops constraints: per-customer feature-flag, canary rollout path (5% -> 25% -> 100%), global kill switch. Add circuit-breaker that disables adaptive batching if error rate or p99 worsens by >10%. Expose batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, p99 in Console charts.

marco_infra: We'll add a nightly perf job for microbatch changes and a quick profiler to produce the perf/cost estimates used by UI. Prefetch TTL for KV cache recommended to avoid cold misses.

rahul_eng: Runtime config snippet for UI display: ```yaml
suggested:
  route: chat
  adaptive_batch: true
  max_wait_ms: 15
  max_batch: 8
  suggest_quant: int8
  est_lat_reduction_pct: 15
  est_cost_delta_pct: 8
```

jenna_product: Proposed pilot gates: (A) staging soak 72h with chat p99 <= target; (B) offline eval job runs <30m and blocks applies above threshold; (C) synthetic regression triggers expected alert; (D) canary + revert tested; (E) docs + runbook published. Two-sprint timeline.

michelle_pm: Action items: rahul - wire UI props + perf estimates; sara - implement eval runner + alert rules; tim - canary controls + circuit-breaker; marco - nightly perf test + profiler; jenna - PRD + UI mocks; alex - get ACME corpora and cost thresholds. Reply here when you start.
